> I just made this little project that helps indicate the driver if they're getting too close when parking. It has 3 lights and a servo that controls the car's brakes. As soon as the ultrasonic sensor detects an object in the red range, it activates the servo motor and slams the brake, saving the car. I'm not exactly sure how you would hit the brakes, and there isn't a module for it, so I just used a servo instead.

## Design

### 2026-10-04 — This project wasn't too hard since I have already done quite a few projects using these resources. I used Tinkercad to make the schematic and to test if it worked.

**0.9h**

This project wasn't too hard since I have already done quite a few projects using these resources. I used Tinkercad to make the schematic and to test if it worked.
First, I just took some LEDs and hooked them up to the Arduino UNO. Since I have always used 4 pin Ultrasonic sensors, it was a little weird figuring out how to use the 3 pin sensors in Tinkercad.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/bba7585d955072a1e4a51e21c107419c4129af982fb170145dade464709aab18.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/595fff4b7e3bcf3c37a8a97d1144af325a44c0d9c81519907876c543d7576f90.png)
But after a while, I was able to figure it out. Then I had to decide what qualified as red, yellow, and green. Realistically, the red range would be somewhere around 10 to 15cm, but since it was hard to test it, I used these parameters: 0-79 is red, 80 to 160 is yellow, and 160+ is green. Those are unrealistic, but for testing purposes, it should be fine.
Then I came up with the idea to have a braking system too as this was a bit boring. I decided to use a servo motor as it felt the best, like a foot slamming down the brakes. When I was first coding it, there was a problem with the servo and it wouldn't move, but after a while of searching around, I found out I connected the power cable to the ground. After I fixed that, the program was all good to go.
One thing I would like to have fixed was making the servo head a different piece, but thats just aesthetics so I figured to just let it be.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/6NsErT1120V2FDTcxwPhvTmpArnC2ArA/ffa223cdc7df4c1c3fe8eb712e227b91fce54634dc08326444a530987d8a002c.png)

tl:dr : I  made a car safety mechanism that automatically brakes when it gets too close to something when parking.
